convert_instructblipvideo_checkpoint: convert an InstructBlipVideo original Salesforce LAVIS checkpoint to a Hugging Face PyTorch model
build_blip2_config: build an InstructBlipVideoConfig from a model name with vision, text, and QFormer configurations
create_rename_keys: create a list of weight key renames mapping original LAVIS checkpoint keys to Hugging Face keys
read_q_v_bias: read and concatenate q and v biases from original model into a single qkv bias tensor
load_demo_image: load a demo image from a URL for verifying checkpoint conversion correctness
